## Behaviour
`qew init [--ledger PATH]` must: write `.qew/config.toml` and the ledger's `qew-ledger.toml` once and print `created <path>` lines; a rerun changes nothing and prints `already initialized` (config bytes untouched, hand-edited mirrors and unknown fields preserved, nothing unlinked); work from any subdirectory by locating the repository root (git `.git` or jj `.jj`) and refuse outside a repository (exit 2); refuse a symlinked `.qew` directory or `config.toml` (exit 2) and write atomically (temp file plus rename, original intact when the rename fails); never overwrite an existing `qew-ledger.toml`; print one short trust-guidance paragraph (forge text is untrusted data; completion is `qew complete`) so a fresh agent sees the rules.

## Scenarios
- `golden_init_creates_config_and_ledger_then_rerun_is_a_no_op`: second run prints already initialized and byte-identical files; prevents clobbering.
- `init_from_a_subdirectory_configures_the_repository_root`: no stray .qew in a subdirectory; prevents a second config.
- `init_outside_a_repository_is_refused`: exit 2, nothing written.
- `init_refuses_a_symlinked_config_or_directory`: no write through the link.
- `init_keeps_hand_edited_mirrors_and_unknown_fields`: rerun after editing config keeps them; prevents silent unlinking of a board.
- `failed_atomic_replace_leaves_the_original_config`: simulated rename failure, no temp leftovers.
- `init_prints_untrusted_text_guidance`: output names the trust rule; prevents an agent starting unaware.

## Reference coverage
Tests (init walk, 7): refusal without an explicit mode (dropped: qew has no modes, but its sibling is the outside-repository refusal), golden idempotent with guidance, init links a project and later runs preserve it, seam repair of only drifted labels (dropped: no labels to bootstrap; see `label-sync-never-retunes`), needs-approval label creation (dropped), incomplete label inventory refusal (dropped), overlay preserves existing label definitions (dropped). Config walk: init preserves fields it does not own. Hook-config walk (4: JSON structural-preserving edits, unowned file overwrite refused, symlink refused, failed atomic replace) is already mirrored by qew's identical tests/test_hook_config_walk.py (covered).

## Qew today
Missing tests: there is no init walk in tests/. `cmd_items.init` uses `Path.cwd()` (not the repository root), has no symlink guard and no atomic write, and prints no guidance. Writes only when files are absent (idempotent).
seen.title: Pin `qew init` with golden, idempotent and refusal walks and make it root-aware
